articles.summary: Evotec SE today announced that its shareholders approved most of the proposals the Company’s Management put to vote at the Company’s Annual General Meeting 2025 with great majority.
articles.title: Evotec SE: Results of the Annual General Meeting 2025

articles.summary: Evotec SE announced that it has joined the NURTuRE AKI consortium for establishing a patient cohort for acute kidney injury (AKI), NURTuRE AKI.
articles.title: Evotec joins NURTuRE-AKI consortium
